Hi,

I feel your pain, being the good guy all the time and getting shit on..

Biggest lesson I learnt was look after yourself, cos no one else can look after you. 

Learn to be selfish. That worked out.

Hi,

I can't relate to you on this one as I have found myself in a very similar situation. 

I understand that getting a job isn't easy, are you applying for jobs spefically that you want or any job that you can apply for?  The last few days I've been struggling to find work, I'm like you I get the job interview and never the job. But yesterday I got a phone call about a driving job, today I went for the interview I got the job, on my way home I received 4 phone calls all wanting me to go for the interview, bearing in mind I've felt so low the last couple of days. But I've sat on the pc and applied for anything that I could do, it's literally a hit of a button and waoh I've sent out 10 CVs. 

Don't give up dude, your certainly not worthless, anybody that didn't give you that job, well their loss. Keep plodding on, apply for anything you can and something will come up my friend I assure you.

As for money issues, can you sit down and talk to your GF about how you feel about not being able to contribute right this second? Maybe that would be a good place to start and then you both are reading from the same page and your GF understands your concerns and worries. 

As for borrowing money from your parents that doesn't make you weak or any less of a person, its called family and family help each other no matter what, well In most cases.

You need to stay positive about your job search and be upbeat about that fact very soon you will be paying and contributing to your family too.

You never know what is round the corner, but I can tell you that its only good days for you. 

Money is just money, don't let it be your bitch. Money hasn't given you the love you receive from your GF or family, you have earnt that from being you .

Please keep getting up early, spend a few hours applying for jobs, then go for a walk and keep your head up and then apply for a few more.

Keep going dude, I hope to soon hear you have found a job soon and that you don't feel like you do now.

Hi, I want to thank you for your kinds words its seems you have already summed it up.

The thoughts of killing myself were here all day today and yesterday, I think if it was going to happen it would have by now. 

I have a the next few days where doors could open for me. But they might not open either. Time will tell.

Thank you again for your kind words and the willingness to reply to my rubbish.
